effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing your top security card, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon and gain 1 memory.
[On Deletion] ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security is reduced, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
